records.people: Somphao Phaysith (spelled Somphao Phaisith by the bank)
records.move: President of the Management Board of Joint Development Bank (2007-2009), then Governor of the Bank of the Lao PDR (2009-2018)
records.summary: Joint Development Bank's own history page lists 'Mr. Somphao Phaisith (2007-2009)' as president of its Management Board. The same page says the bank opened on 3 October 1989 as a joint venture in which 'Thai investors represented by Phongsouvan Sailo and Opphuad held 70% of the Bank's shares, while the Lao side, represented by the Bank of the Lao PDR, held the remaining 30%', and that after the 2012 share transfer to Simoung Group JDB became 'a 100% Lao-owned private commercial bank'. So during Somphao Phaisith's 2007-2009 term the bank's shares were 70% in the hands of named Thai investors and 30% with the central bank. Wikipedia's list of heads of the Lao central bank gives Somphao Phaysith as governor from 2009 to 2018, immediately after the JDB term.
records.source_title: Joint Development Bank - About (Public in Brief; list of Presidents of the Management Board)
records.ownership_quote: Thai investors represented by Phongsouvan Sailo and Opphuad held 70% of the Bank's shares, while the Lao side, represented by the Bank of the Lao PDR, held the remaining 30%. ... On 15 June 2010, the Bank of the Lao PDR transferred all of its shares to the Thai investor Mr. Silod Singsomboun ... resulting in JDB becoming a 100% Lao-owned private commercial bank.

records.move: Deputy Chairman of the National Bank of Solomon Islands, and a board member of the Central Bank of Solomon Islands
records.summary: The Central Bank of Solomon Islands lists board member David K.C. Quan with the past role 'Deputy Chairman - National Bank of Solomon Islands (NBSI)'. It gives no years for that role, so the period cannot be matched to a particular owner. On the ownership of that bank, American Banker reported on 4 November 1994 that 'Bank of Hawaii said it has acquired a 51% interest in the National Bank of Solomon Islands', with 'The Solomon Islands National Provident Fund is the owner of the remaining interest in the commercial bank' - a 51% stake held by a Honolulu bank alongside the Solomon Islands pension fund. The same board page also shows Quan as Managing Director of Quan Chee Corporation Limited and as a past Chairman of the Solomon Islands National Provident Fund, which is a statutory pension body and therefore public.

records.years: 2007-2017 at the Central Bank of Seychelles; Manager of BMI Offshore Bank Ltd November 2014 to June 2015; central bank board director from 1 January 2024
records.move: Director of Financial Services Supervision at the Central Bank of Seychelles, delegated as Manager of BMI Offshore Bank Ltd (Nov 2014 - June 2015), later appointed a director of the central bank's board
records.summary: Seychelles Nation reports that Jean-Paul Barbier 'joined CBS in 2007 as a Financial Services Analyst in the Financial Services Supervision Division', rose to Director of that division, left in 2017, and was 'delegated the role of Manager of BMI Offshore Bank Ltd from November 2014 to June 2015'; he was then appointed to the Central Bank of Seychelles board from 1 January 2024. On who owned that bank, an offshore-banking directory page states 'BMIO Bank is a joint venture between Bahrein Muscat International (BMI) Bank and Nouvobanq Seychelles', each with 50% shareholdings, and lists BMI's shareholders as 'BankMuscat (Oman), Royal Court Affairs (Oman), Overseas Investment (Bahrain), Istithmar World (UAE), Global Investment House (Kuwait) and Financial Assets Bahrain (Bahrain)', while 'Nouvobanq ... is jointly owned by Government of Seychelles (78%) and Standard Chartered (22%)'. That shareholder table mixes state holders with company holders, and it comes from a commercial directory rather than from the bank itself, so the ownership figure wants a second source.
records.source_title: Seychelles Nation - CBS thanks outgoing member of its Board and welcomes new Board director
records.quote: delegated the role of Manager of BMI Offshore Bank Ltd from November 2014 to June 2015
records.ownership_quote: BMIO Bank is a joint venture between Bahrein Muscat International (BMI) Bank and Nouvobanq Seychelles (each with 50% shareholdings). BMI's shareholders are BankMuscat (Oman), Royal Court Affairs (Oman), Overseas Investment (Bahrain), Istithmar World (UAE), Global Investment House (Kuwait) and Financial Assets Bahrain (Bahrain). Nouvobanq is one of the largest Banks in the Seychelles and is jointly owned by Government of Seychelles (78%) and Standard Chartered (22%).

held.why_held: No biography of any member of the BCSM Consiglio Direttivo or of its Direttore Generale was retrieved. Italian-language searches returned only Consiglio Grande e Generale session pages, which name appointments without careers. The one news item that looked like a career note, bluerating.com's 'SanMarino, Giannini e il nuovo direttore della Banca Centrale', returned a client error on two separate attempts and needs a hand check.

No career list for any chairman or deputy chairman was obtained, and no Turkmen financial firm was found with any stated private ownership. Turkmen and Russian searches returned only appointment notices.

The central bank's board page names the non-executive directors but carries no biographies, and the Governor's biography on the bank's own site and in an IMF seminar profile lists only Central Bank of Samoa posts. No private financial employer was reached.

For the Aden administration, Al Arabiya's profile of governor Ahmed Ghaleb Al-Mu'abqi (appointed December 2021) lists the Ministry of Finance, the Tax Authority and the Arab Monetary Fund, all public bodies, and no private or commercial bank. Nothing was obtained for the Sana'a administration.
